baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II question أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ is set against يَعْلَمُ and عَلِيمٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers try to become causative agents of knowledge, while active and settled divine knowing enclose their attempt; the error is an attempted transfer of epistemic office, not merely a bad datum.

activation_trace.role: Knowing a thing as it becomes clear joins the three forms and exposes the impossible reversal from teaching God to God's own knowing.
Arrogating judgment gives the commanded reply a jurisdictional edge against deciding what God should count as religion.
Ordered civic authority makes دِينِكُمْ a claimed jurisdiction whose right to define is under challenge.

changed_reading.before: God already knows the religion they report.
changed_reading.after: Their report tries to install them as definers and God as the recipient of their ruling; the question restores the direction of authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive بِدِينِكُمْ is the item they purport to transmit to God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reckoning, debt, and credit branches of dīn let the possessive phrase behave like a submitted account: they tender a claim that is supposed to credit itself, although the knower of every thing does not accept self-entry as proof.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning and recompense turn their religion into an account whose valuation belongs to the divine knower.
Debt and credit supply the ledger image for a self-presented claim of religious standing.
Leaving a matter to another's conscience sharpens the contrast between self-credit and the assessor who already knows it.

changed_reading.before: They tell God which religion they follow.
changed_reading.after: They tender their dīn as an account that should place them in credit, but the account cannot certify itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ expands into بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Upper cover and lower ground establish an enclosing vertical field; totality and the knowable thing close every remaining gap. Their report is already an object inside the knowledge to which it pretends to add.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky supplies the upper cover of the verse's exhaustive knowledge field.
Lower ground opposite the sky supplies the lower bound paired with that cover.
Totality and completeness seal the upper-lower field against exceptions.
The knowable entity makes their own declaration one included object among every thing.

changed_reading.before: The cosmic scope simply emphasizes omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The scope spatially nests the speakers, their utterance, and their dīn inside what they imagine they are supplying from outside.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دِينِكُمْ is presented through speech to the one called عَلِيمٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Doctrine and customary state can function as a public badge, while knowledge as a distinguishing mark asks whether the badge discloses what it claims. The rebuke separates self-classification from known reality.

activation_trace.role: Speech as held doctrine supplies the declarative identity the speakers want accepted.
Habit and customary state make 'your dīn' capable of naming a communal pattern rather than proving an inward condition.
A distinguishing mark activates the question whether an announced badge is evidence or only a sign under examination.

changed_reading.before: The verse corrects an inaccurate religious label.
changed_reading.after: It challenges the attempt to make an inherited or announced badge produce the inward reality it signifies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibitions give epistemic overreach a vertical choreography: advancing ahead of divine authority and raising a voice above mediated instruction become the spatial analogues of presuming to teach God.

activation_trace.role: Arrogated judgment anchors the vertical context back in the focus command and its contested authority.
Forward precedence supplies the motion of putting one's judgment ahead of divine authority.
Raising the voice makes self-assertion an audible elevation, recast in 49:16 as epistemic elevation.
Higher rank supplies the hierarchy crossed when the speaker acts as God's instructor.

structural_cues: 49:1's 'before God and His Messenger' is followed by 49:2's 'above the Prophet's voice'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forbidden precedence and vocal elevation; I infer that instructing God is their epistemic analogue; a live alternative keeps these as separate etiquette rules.

changed_reading.before: Teaching God is an isolated absurdity.
changed_reading.after: It is the climax of a repeated posture of getting ahead, climbing above, and relocating authority upward to oneself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human news normally moves from an arriving report to clarification because the receiver lacks secure knowledge. The focus question removes that receiver deficit: a self-report cannot function as news to God.

activation_trace.role: Clear knowing anchors the contrast between report-dependent human cognition and divine knowledge.
A delivered report supplies the ordinary information-transfer model that the focus interrogative parodies.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the verification step needed by humans but not by the divine knower.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders clarification after news arrives, whereas 49:16 immediately answers the proposed informing with exhaustive knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a report-verification sequence and an omniscience claim; I infer a contrast between receiver conditions; alternatively 49:6 may remain only an ethical rule for human reports.

changed_reading.after: Their statement mistakes God for a report-dependent recipient, so even a factually correct self-report could not occupy the role they give it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context fixes direction twice: making the Messenger comply with the group would cause hardship, while God gently directs the group. 'Teaching God your dīn' attempts to reverse both obedience and guidance.

activation_trace.role: Obedience and submission anchor the question in the direction of compliance carried by dīn.
Compliance supplies the rejected arrow from prophetic authority toward the group's wishes.
Gentle direction to the path supplies the opposite, valid arrow from God toward the speakers.

structural_cues: 49:7 imagines the Messenger obeying the group; 49:17 names God as the one who guided them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed compliance and guidance directions; I infer that teaching God repeats the invalid direction at the level of knowledge; alternatively the three relations need not form one system.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies that they can add to God's knowledge.
changed_reading.after: It also denies their attempted reversal of who directs whom within dīn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Names and social marks enable people to recognize one another, but knowledge of the inside of a matter exceeds recognition by badge. The announced dīn is therefore a sign available for assessment, not a verdict that binds God.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors the model in the focus contrast between a sign and the knowledge it may or may not disclose.
Name as raised designation supplies the public label that can circulate independently of inward reality.
Recognition after a trace or mark supplies the legitimate but limited social function of identifiers.
Knowledge of the report and the matter's interior supplies the depth that public naming lacks.

structural_cues: 49:11's reciprocal nicknaming and epithet constructions use the branchless roots ن ب ز and ل ق ب only as structural evidence of contested naming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies names, marks, mutual recognition, and interior knowledge; I infer that 'your dīn' is being offered as a badge; alternatively the naming rules may concern social harm without bearing on 49:16.

changed_reading.before: Their religious name is simply inaccurate.
changed_reading.after: Religious naming is a useful social mark that becomes presumptuous when offered as exhaustive knowledge of the person before God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human inquiry can move from uncertain suspicion into covert searching; the focus's triple knowledge root denies that God reaches their state by either route. Their volunteered instruction answers an investigative need that does not exist.

activation_trace.role: Clear knowing anchors the divine mode against uncertain or invasive human acquisition.
Doubt and imagining supply the unstable starting point of human judgment about hidden states.
Secretly tracking a report supplies the invasive acquisition route prohibited to humans and unnecessary for God.

structural_cues: 49:12 places suspicion before spying, creating a possible uncertainty-to-investigation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suspicion and covert inquiry; I supply their sequence as an epistemic route contrasted with divine knowing; alternatively the prohibitions are parallel rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: God does not need their testimony.
changed_reading.after: God needs neither testimony nor the uncertain and invasive evidentiary route by which humans try to reach concealed states.

context_deltas.mechanism: Facing groups and recognition by marks create workable social classifications, while honor is evaluated at God. The customary branch of dīn can therefore be heard as a local social order mistakenly projected as a cosmic rank.

activation_trace.role: Customary state anchors 'your dīn' as a group-shaped practice capable of being mistaken for ultimate rank.
A group whose members face one another supplies the social formation of tribes and their internal identity.
Recognition through marks explains what group classifications can legitimately accomplish.
Praiseworthy honor supplies the rank that social identity cannot award to itself before God.

structural_cues: 49:13 moves from created peoples and tribes, to mutual recognition, to comparative honor 'at God'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group formation, recognition, and divine rank; I infer that customary dīn may be one local classifier; alternatively dīn here need not carry its habit branch.

changed_reading.before: The speakers report a personal religious condition.
changed_reading.after: They may be universalizing a local group order and asking the cosmic knower to ratify its social rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context separates spoken doctrine, outward handing-over, entry, and the heart's core. 'Your dīn' no longer names one flat possession; it is a layered claim whose announced exterior has not yet crossed the stated interior threshold.

activation_trace.role: Obedience and submission anchor the outward religious relation whose depth is disputed.
Speech as doctrine supplies the self-classifying layer expressed by 'we believe' and corrected by another formula.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward condition that the utterance claims before it is present.
Handing over and relinquishing supply an outward submission distinguishable from settled inward trust.
Entry into an inside gives faith a threshold and makes the missing transition spatially explicit.
The pure core of a thing supplies the interior destination that public speech cannot certify.

structural_cues: 49:14 orders three speech acts around a temporal negation: faith has 'not yet' entered their hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corrected formulas, outward submission, and failed heart-entry; I infer a layered diagnostic that 49:16 calls 'your dīn'; alternatively 49:16 may rebuke only the original faith claim.

changed_reading.before: Their declared religious label is wrong.
changed_reading.after: Their declaration flattens distinct layers of utterance, surrender, entry, and settled heart-state into a possession they presume to explain to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expenditure under difficulty realizes truth in deed, and the closing vision is directed to what people do. The focus rebuke therefore shifts dīn from declarative content to a temporal pattern that must become actual.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the mode whose sufficiency is being denied.
Exerting full capacity under hardship supplies costly duration rather than instantaneous self-description.
Making a promise real in action supplies the mechanism by which a claim becomes truthful.
Intentional deed supplies the observable continuation against which the declared dīn is read.

structural_cues: 49:15 defines the truthful through persistence and striving; 49:18 closes on what 'you do'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly striving, truth realized in action, and divine sight of deeds; I infer that these verify the focus claim over time; alternatively they may describe exemplars without defining all dīn.

changed_reading.before: Religion is information contained in a declaration.
changed_reading.after: Religion is a lived trajectory whose truth is realized through costly action and is already available to divine sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers treat their submission as owned capital and remind the addressee of it like a creditor. The context reverses the account: submission is a handing-over, reminders burden recipients, and guidance arrives as God's gift to them.

activation_trace.role: Debt and credit anchor the focus phrase as an account the speakers think favors them.
Handing over and relinquishing make submission a yielded relation rather than an asset retained for leverage.
Burdening a beneficiary by rehearsing a favor supplies the speakers' attempted creditor posture and its explicit reversal.
A gracious gift to one held in affection relocates benefaction from the speakers to God.

structural_cues: 49:17 repeats the favor verb across their claim, its prohibition, and God's counterclaim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the threefold favor reversal and gifted guidance; I connect it to the focus root's debt-credit branches; alternatively the correction can remain moral without a ledger metaphor.

changed_reading.before: They claim that God should recognize their religion.
changed_reading.after: They present religion as credit owed to them, but the account reverses: they are recipients of guidance and cannot invoice its giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah covers concealed reality through knowledge and enacted reality through sight. A religious self-report cannot fill a gap between inner state and outward conduct because both channels are already covered.

activation_trace.role: The knowable thing anchors every hidden state and deed inside the focus claim's universal object range.
What is screened from eyes supplies the concealed channel already open to divine knowledge.
Direct seeing supplies the complementary channel aimed at conduct.
Intentional action supplies the visible evidence that stands beside the unseen heart-state.

structural_cues: 49:18 pairs knowledge of the unseen heavens and earth with sight of what the addressees do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden reality, divine sight, and deeds; I infer two exhaustive evidentiary channels; alternatively knowing and seeing may be parallel attributes without diagnostic division.

changed_reading.before: The cosmic formula merely repeats that God knows everything.
changed_reading.after: The repetition closes both possible escape routes for the self-report: concealed inward reality and observable outward action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the non-dominant split maps ق و ل to a fewness branch that is not the lexical sense of قُلْ; it remains anchored to focus word 1 and to the context's inflated reminder of favor; downstream prose should render it only as formal resonance, never as translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The one-word imperative قُلْ launches a compact correction to an expansive claim about دِينِكُمْ.

activation_trace.role: Fewness and smallness make the commanded utterance formally spare, deflating the speakers' enlarged self-account.
Rehearsing a favor supplies the inflated discourse that the minimal corrective cuts down to scale.

changed_reading.after: The response's verbal economy itself may enact the reduction of an overgrown claim to religious credit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because weariness is a collateral branch of ك ل ل, not the sense of كُلِّ here; it remains tightly anchored to word 14 beside repeated knowledge language; downstream prose should mark it as a counter-image activated by totality, not lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بِكُلِّ places exhaustive scope immediately before عَلِيمٌ.

activation_trace.role: Weariness and loss of sharpness supply the failure mode that exhaustive knowing implicitly excludes.
Totality and completeness supply the maximal load under which divine knowledge remains undulled.

changed_reading.after: Exhaustive extension is carried without the fatigue or blunting that total load would produce in a finite knower.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س م م target behind س م و and its private-inner-circle image; it remains anchored in the packet's supplied split mapping for ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ and is activated by heart-entry and unseen context; downstream prose should call it an interiority image, not a meaning of 'heavens'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heavens at focus word 9 participate in a split mapping while the verse claims knowledge of their entire contents.

activation_trace.role: A private inner circle supplies an unexpected nested interior within the cosmic field.
The inward secret supplies the concealed destination whose occupancy the speakers misreport.
Screening from eyes supplies concealment without exclusion from divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth mark only maximal external expanse.
changed_reading.after: The cosmic field can also be imagined as nested interiors, including private heart-space, with no sealed chamber outside divine knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the forward-sale branch is not the contextual sense of إِسْلَٰمَكُمْ; it remains anchored through the focus root's explicit debt-credit inventory and 49:17's favor dispute; downstream prose should present an accounting analogy only, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus dīn root carries debt and credit while the next ayah makes their Islam the object of a favor claim.

activation_trace.role: Debt and credit anchor the claimed religion in an accounting frame.
A forward sale or advance payment supplies the strange image of submission tendered now to purchase standing.
Rehearsed benefaction turns the supposed advance into an invoice pressed upon its recipient.

changed_reading.before: They boast that their submission benefits the addressee.
changed_reading.after: They may be imaginatively treating submission as an advance payment that purchases divine recognition, an account the following reversal cancels.

strongest_changes: 49:14 turns the focus claim into a layered diagnostic: spoken doctrine, outward surrender, heart-entry, and settled trust do not collapse into one self-owned label.
49:17 activates the dīn debt-credit branches and reverses the benefactor relation: the speakers cannot invoice the giver of guidance.
49:18 closes both unseen inward reality and visible action, leaving no epistemic gap for self-report to fill.
The opening precedence and voice rules make 'teaching God' the epistemic climax of a repeated authority inversion.
summary.what_was_special: The same short rebuke sustained coexisting jurisdictional, accounting, spatial, social-marker, inward-threshold, and enacted-truth readings. Split mappings added contained resonances of verbal smallness and nested privacy without being promoted to lexical meanings.
remaining_uncertainties: The ledger reading is strongly activated by 49:17 but remains an abductive use of dīn's debt-credit branches rather than a required gloss.
The causal arrows from precedence to epistemic overreach and from suspicion to investigation are reader-supplied; the packet also permits parallel, non-causal relations.
The ق ل ل and س م م split-root outliers are intentionally remote and should remain qualified images.
The focus ayah itself does not name the heart/action distinction; that diagnostic depth depends on the adjacent 49:14-15 and 49:18 sequence.
